want: to see my category spending visualised as a donut chart on the dashboard
soThat: I can immediately grasp the proportional split of my expenses at a glance
acceptance: the category breakdown card shows an animated donut chart with one arc per spending category
the total expense amount is displayed in the centre of the donut
each arc uses a distinct, accessible colour that is consistent per category
tapping a segment highlights it and shows the category name and amount in the centre
below the chart a scrollable list shows each category as a card with a colour dot, name on one line with percentage top-right, and bold amount on the line below
the chart and list are hidden when there are no expense transactions in the period
